# Draft:Minges Brook Mall(Battle Creek, Michigan)

Minges Brook Mall is an open shopping mall serving the southern portion of the city of Battle Creek, Michigan. It finished construction in 1988 and opened in 1989 and features the sixteenth Target, a Disc Traders, Sally Beauty Supply, a Burn Boot Camp, an Asian Hibachi Grill Buffet, an office for the Social Security Administration, a Dollar Tree, a Once Upon a Child, an AAA Travel office, a One Main Financial branch, a Discount Hobby, an ABC Warehouse, a Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa, a Jimmy John's, a local fur shop, Burtrum Furs of Battle Creek, a Farmers Insurance Branch, and a Mega-Bev.
1989/1990 Occupancy
The mall originally contained 12 units with the anchor stores being the 16th Target, F&M Distributors, Felpausch, and a Witmark Catalog Store.
